IS 3963 : 1987 Roof extractor unitsUDC 621.639ETD 32Reaffirmed 20141 Scope1.1 This standard specifies the requirements and tests for roofextractor units in which the extraction fan is driven by anelectric motor operated from either single-phase supply voltage notexceeding 250 volts or three-phase supply voltage not exceeding 440volts. It covers This types of roof extractor units:a) Vertijet type in which there are two or more shutters (onthe top of the cowl) which open only when the fan is operated andthe air leaves the weather-protection casing vertically upwardssubstantially parallel to the axis of the fan impeller, andb) `Cowl type in which the top of the weather-protection casingis closed and the air driven vertically upwards by the fan impellerrebounds from the top of the cowl and leaves the casing downwardsthrough openings at its sides1.2 This standard also covers speed regulators, if any,associated with the extractor fans.1.3 This standard does not cover units in which the fan impelleris not directly driven by the motor.2 ReferencesIS 2 :1960Rules for rounding off numerical valuesIS 302 :1979General and safety requirements for householdand similar electrical appliancesIS 585 :1962Voltages and frequency for transmission anddistribution systemsIS 1248 : Part 1 :1983Specification for direct actingindicatinganalogue electrical measuring instruments andtheir accessories:Part 1 General requirementsIS 1271 :1985Thermal evaluation and classification ofelectrical insulationIS 1401 :1970Accessibility test probesIS 1709 :1984Specification for capacitors for electric fanmotorsIS 1885 : Part 55 :1981Electrotechnical vocabulary:Part 55 Electric fans
